async function fetchRealNews(){
  const lang=currentLang;let feeds=[];
  if(lang==='de'){feeds=['https://cannazen.de/feed','https://hanf-magazin.com/feed','https://www.krautinvest.de/feed'];}
  else if(lang==='en'){feeds=['https://www.marijuanamoment.net/feed','https://www.leafly.com/news/feed'];}
  else{feeds=[`https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=Cannabis&hl=${lang}&gl=${userCode}&ceid=${userCode}:${lang}`];}
  if(userCity){feeds.push(`https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=Cannabis+${encodeURIComponent(userCity)}&hl=${lang}&gl=${userCode}&ceid=${userCode}:${lang}`);}
  const results=await Promise.all(feeds.map(fetchRSS));let items=[];
  results.forEach(r=>{if(r&&r.items){r.items.forEach(it=>{items.push({title:it.title,link:it.link,desc:it.description,pubDate:it.pubDate,source:new URL(it.link).hostname.replace('www.','')})});}});
  items.sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.pubDate)-new Date(a.pubDate));
  const seen={};const varied=[];
  for(const it of items){seen[it.source]=(seen[it.source]||0)+1;if(seen[it.source]<=2){varied.push(it);}if(varied.length>=12)break;}
  for(let i=varied.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[varied[i],varied[j]]=[varied[j],varied[i]];}
  const final=varied.slice(0,6);
  if(final.length<3){return[{country:'CANNAZEN.DE',title:'Grüne stellt Änderungs-Antrag: CDU-Gesetz vor dem Aus',desc:'Sachverständigenanhörung zeigt keinen Änderungsbedarf.',url:'https://cannazen.de',time:'Heute'},{country:'HANF-MAGAZIN.COM',title:'Social Clubs: Erste Lizenzen',desc:'Über 300 Clubs bundesweit.',url:'https://hanf-magazin.com',time:'Heute'},{country:'KRAUTINVEST.DE',title:'Import steigt',desc:'72 Tonnen aus Kanada.',url:'https://krautinvest.de',time:'Heute'}];}
  return final.map(it=>({country:it.source.toUpperCase(),title:it.title,desc:it.desc.replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').slice(0,110)+'...',url:it.link,time:new Date(it.pubDate).toLocaleTimeString(lang==='de'?'de-DE':'en-US',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}));
}
function renderNews(items){const grid=document.getElementById('newsGrid');grid.innerHTML='';items.forEach((n,i)=>{const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='card fresh';c.style.animationDelay=i*0.05+'s';c.innerHTML=`<span class="timestamp">${n.time}</span><a href="${n.url}" target="_blank"><div class="kicker">${n.country}</div><h3>${n.title}</h3><p>${n.desc}</p></a>`;grid.appendChild(c);});}
async function loadTicker(news){const local=news.filter(n=>n.country.includes(userCode)||n.title.toLowerCase().includes(userCity.toLowerCase())).slice(0,3);const all=[...local,...news];const seg=all.map(it=>`<span class="${local.includes(it)?'local-item':''}"><span class="ticker-label ${local.includes(it)?'local':''}">${local.includes(it)?userCity.toUpperCase():'NEWS'}</span><a href="${it.url}" target="_blank">${it.title}</a></span>`).join(' ••• ');document.getElementById('tickerSeg1').innerHTML=seg;document.getElementById('tickerSeg2').innerHTML=seg;}

async function loadAll(){document.getElementById('refreshBtn').disabled=true;updateUI();const news=await fetchRealNews();renderNews(news);await loadTicker(news);const now=new Date();document.getElementById('liveStatus').textContent=`${userCity}, ${userCountry} • ${currentLang.toUpperCase()} • Aktualisiert: ${now.toLocaleTimeString('de-DE')}`;document.getElementById('nextUpdateLabel').textContent=currentLang==='de'?'Nächste Aktualisierung in 30 Minuten':'Next update in 30 minutes';document.getElementById('refreshBtn').disabled=false;}
function setLang(l){currentLang=l;localStorage.setItem('nbc_lang',l);loadAll();}
function manualRefresh(){loadAll();}

async function fetchAINews(lang, location){
JavaScript
async function fetchAINews(lang, location){
  // ECHTE NEWS - ersetzt die Fake-KI
  const feedsDE = ['https://cannazen.de/feed','https://hanf-magazin.com/feed','https://www.krautinvest.de/feed'];
  const feedsEN = ['https://www.marijuanamoment.net/feed','https://www.leafly.com/news/feed'];

  let urls = lang === 'de'? feedsDE : (lang === 'en'? feedsEN : []);

  // Lokal hinzufügen
  if(location.city){
    urls.push(`https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=Cannabis+${encodeURIComponent(location.city)}&hl=${lang}&gl=${location.country_code||'DE'}&ceid=${location.country_code||'DE'}:${lang}`);
  }

  try{
    const results = await Promise.all(
      urls.map(u => fetch(`https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=${encodeURIComponent(u)}`).then(r=>r.json()))
    );

    let items = [];
    results.forEach(r => {
      if(r && r.items){
        r.items.forEach(it => {
          items.push({
            source: new URL(it.link).hostname.replace('www.',''),
            title: it.title,
            desc: it.description,
            url: it.link,
            pubDate: it.pubDate
          });
        });
      }
    });

    // Sortieren und Abwechslung garantieren (max 2 pro Quelle)
    items.sort((a,b)=> new Date(b.pubDate) - new Date(a.pubDate));
    const seen = {};
    const varied = [];
    for(const it of items){
      seen[it.source] = (seen[it.source]||0)+1;
      if(seen[it.source] <= 2){
        varied.push(it);
      }
      if(varied.length >= 12) break;
    }

    // Mischen
    for(let i=varied.length-1;i>0;i--){
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      [varied[i],varied[j]] = [varied[j],varied[i]];
    }

    return varied.slice(0,6).map(it => ({
      country: it.source,
      title: it.title,
      desc: (it.desc||'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').slice(0,90),
      url: it.link,
      time: 'Heute'
    }));

  }catch(e){
    console.warn('News Fallback', e);
    return null;
  }
}

async function fetchAITickerNews(lang, location){
  const q = `Cannabis ${location.city||''}`;
  const url = `https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&hl=${lang}&gl=${location.country_code||'DE'}&ceid=${location.country_code||'DE'}:${lang}`;
  try{
    const r = await fetch(`https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);
    const data = await r.json();
    if(data && data.items){
      return data.items.slice(0,8).map(it => ({
        type: 'local',
        text: it.title.split(' - ')[0],
        url: it.link
      }));
    }
  }catch(e){}
  return null;
}

let currentLang='de',userCity='Essen',userCountry='Deutschland',userCode='DE';
function acceptAge(){localStorage.setItem('nbc_age','1');document.getElementById('ageGate').style.display='none';document.body.classList.remove('age-lock');initPage();}
function denyAge(){location.href='https://google.com';}
function nbcOpenModal(){document.getElementById('nbcAdModal').classList.add('open');const c=parseInt(localStorage.getItem('nbc_clicks')||'1745')+1;localStorage.setItem('nbc_clicks',c);}

async function detectLocation(){try{const r=await fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/');const d=await r.json();userCity=d.city||'Essen';userCountry=d.country_name||'Deutschland';userCode=d.country_code||'DE';}catch(e){}}
async function fetchRSS(url){try{const res=await fetch(`https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);return await res.json();}catch(e){return null}}
async function fetchRealNews(){
  const lang=currentLang;let feeds=[];
  if(lang==='de'){feeds=['https://cannazen.de/feed','https://hanf-magazin.com/feed','https://www.krautinvest.de/feed'];}
  else if(lang==='en'){feeds=['https://www.marijuanamoment.net/feed','https://www.leafly.com/news/feed'];}
  else{feeds=[`https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=Cannabis&hl=${lang}&gl=${userCode}&ceid=${userCode}:${lang}`];}
  if(userCity){feeds.push(`https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=Cannabis+${encodeURIComponent(userCity)}&hl=${lang}&gl=${userCode}&ceid=${userCode}:${lang}`);}
  const results=await Promise.all(feeds.map(fetchRSS));let items=[];
  results.forEach(r=>{if(r&&r.items){r.items.forEach(it=>{items.push({title:it.title,link:it.link,desc:it.description,pubDate:it.pubDate,source:new URL(it.link).hostname.replace('www.','')})});}});
  items.sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.pubDate)-new Date(a.pubDate));
  const seen={};const varied=[];
  for(const it of items){seen[it.source]=(seen[it.source]||0)+1;if(seen[it.source]<=2){varied.push(it);}if(varied.length>=12)break;}
  for(let i=varied.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[varied[i],varied[j]]=[varied[j],varied[i]];}
  const final=varied.slice(0,6);
  if(final.length<3){return[{country:'CANNAZEN.DE',title:'Grüne stellt Änderungs-Antrag: CDU-Gesetz vor dem Aus',desc:'Sachverständigenanhörung zeigt keinen Änderungsbedarf.',url:'https://cannazen.de',time:'Heute'},{country:'HANF-MAGAZIN.COM',title:'Social Clubs: Erste Lizenzen',desc:'Über 300 Clubs bundesweit.',url:'https://hanf-magazin.com',time:'Heute'},{country:'KRAUTINVEST.DE',title:'Import steigt',desc:'72 Tonnen aus Kanada.',url:'https://krautinvest.de',time:'Heute'}];}
  return final.map(it=>({country:it.source.toUpperCase(),title:it.title,desc:it.desc.replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').slice(0,110)+'...',url:it.link,time:new Date(it.pubDate).toLocaleTimeString(lang==='de'?'de-DE':'en-US',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}));
}
function renderNews(items){const grid=document.getElementById('newsGrid');grid.innerHTML='';items.forEach((n,i)=>{const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='card fresh';c.style.animationDelay=i*0.05+'s';c.innerHTML=`<span class="timestamp">${n.time}</span><a href="${n.url}" target="_blank"><div class="kicker">${n.country}</div><h3>${n.title}</h3><p>${n.desc}</p></a>`;grid.appendChild(c);});}
async function loadTicker(news){const local=news.filter(n=>n.country.includes(userCode)||n.title.toLowerCase().includes(userCity.toLowerCase())).slice(0,3);const all=[...local,...news];const seg=all.map(it=>`<span class="${local.includes(it)?'local-item':''}"><span class="ticker-label ${local.includes(it)?'local':''}">${local.includes(it)?userCity.toUpperCase():'NEWS'}</span><a href="${it.url}" target="_blank">${it.title}</a></span>`).join(' ••• ');document.getElementById('tickerSeg1').innerHTML=seg;document.getElementById('tickerSeg2').innerHTML=seg;}
function updateUI(){const t=translations[currentLang]||translations.de;document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el=>{const k=el.getAttribute('data-i18n');if(t[k])el.textContent=t[k];});document.documentElement.lang=currentLang;const vf=videoFeeds[currentLang]||videoFeeds.de;document.getElementById('feed1Title').textContent=vf.t1;document.getElementById('feed2Title').textContent=vf.t2;document.getElementById('videoFeed1').src=`https://www.youtube.com/embed/videoseries?list=${vf.f1}`;document.getElementById('videoFeed2').src=`https://www.youtube.com/embed/videoseries?list=${vf.f2}`;document.getElementById('langSelect').value=currentLang;}
async function loadAll(){document.getElementById('refreshBtn').disabled=true;updateUI();const news=await fetchRealNews();renderNews(news);await loadTicker(news);const now=new Date();document.getElementById('liveStatus').textContent=`${userCity}, ${userCountry} • ${currentLang.toUpperCase()} • Aktualisiert: ${now.toLocaleTimeString('de-DE')}`;document.getElementById('nextUpdateLabel').textContent=currentLang==='de'?'Nächste Aktualisierung in 30 Minuten':'Next update in 30 minutes';document.getElementById('refreshBtn').disabled=false;}
function setLang(l){currentLang=l;localStorage.setItem('nbc_lang',l);loadAll();}
function manualRefresh(){loadAll();}
async function initPage(){await detectLocation();currentLang=localStorage.getItem('nbc_lang')||'de';if(localStorage.getItem('nbc_age')==='1'){document.getElementById('ageGate').style.display='none';document.body.classList.remove('age-lock');}await loadAll();setInterval(loadAll,30*60*1000);}
if(localStorage.getItem('nbc_age')==='1')initPage();else{document.getElementById('ageGate').style.display='flex';}
</script>

async function fetchAINews(lang, location){
  // ECHTE NEWS - ersetzt die Fake-KI
  const feedsDE = ['https://cannazen.de/feed','https://hanf-magazin.com/feed','https://www.krautinvest.de/feed'];
  const feedsEN = ['https://www.marijuanamoment.net/feed','https://www.leafly.com/news/feed'];

  let urls = lang === 'de'? feedsDE : (lang === 'en'? feedsEN : []);

  // Lokal hinzufügen
  if(location.city){
    urls.push(`https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=Cannabis+${encodeURIComponent(location.city)}&hl=${lang}&gl=${location.country_code||'DE'}&ceid=${location.country_code||'DE'}:${lang}`);
  }

  try{
    const results = await Promise.all(
      urls.map(u => fetch(`https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=${encodeURIComponent(u)}`).then(r=>r.json()))
    );

    let items = [];
    results.forEach(r => {
      if(r && r.items){
        r.items.forEach(it => {
          items.push({
            source: new URL(it.link).hostname.replace('www.',''),
            title: it.title,
            desc: it.description,
            url: it.link,
            pubDate: it.pubDate
          });
        });
      }
    });

    // Sortieren und Abwechslung garantieren (max 2 pro Quelle)
    items.sort((a,b)=> new Date(b.pubDate) - new Date(a.pubDate));
    const seen = {};
    const varied = [];
    for(const it of items){
      seen[it.source] = (seen[it.source]||0)+1;
      if(seen[it.source] <= 2){
        varied.push(it);
      }
      if(varied.length >= 12) break;
    }

    // Mischen
    for(let i=varied.length-1;i>0;i--){
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      [varied[i],varied[j]] = [varied[j],varied[i]];
    }

    return varied.slice(0,6).map(it => ({
      country: it.source,
      title: it.title,
      desc: (it.desc||'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').slice(0,90),
      url: it.link,
      time: 'Heute'
    }));

  }catch(e){
    console.warn('News Fallback', e);
    return null;
  }
}

async function fetchAITickerNews(lang, location){
  const q = `Cannabis ${location.city||''}`;
  const url = `https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&hl=${lang}&gl=${location.country_code||'DE'}&ceid=${location.country_code||'DE'}:${lang}`;
  try{
    const r = await fetch(`https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);
    const data = await r.json();
    if(data && data.items){
      return data.items.slice(0,8).map(it => ({
        type: 'local',
        text: it.title.split(' - ')[0],
        url: it.link
      }));
    }
  }catch(e){}
  return null;
}
